question: What are the advantages of cloud computing?
reference_answer: Cloud computing delivers computing services such as servers, storage and applications on demand over the internet with pay-as-you-go pricing. It offers scalability and elasticity, high accessibility from anywhere, reduced infrastructure and maintenance cost, and service models such as IaaS, PaaS and SaaS deployed on public, private or hybrid clouds.

concepts.concept: On-demand delivery of computing services over the internet
Cost efficiency — pay as you go, less infrastructure
